claims.statement: If a restriction-closed Boolean class C satisfies G<=aI+bU with a>=0 and 0<=b<1, then its closure under fresh disjoint finite products of signed point defects, fair half-activation, and arbitrary physical restrictions satisfies G<=(max(a,5)+8/(ln2(1-ln2)))I+bU.
claims.scope: All finite dimensions, depths, point-defect ranks including r=1, sign patterns, finite numbers of disjoint defect factors, and physical restrictions; fresh disjoint variables and fair selectors.

claims.statement: The assertion I(F_d)>=1 in the prior positive point-defect GU transfer is false; for the displayed two-level tower with constant seed, I(F_2)=3/4+(r+1/2)2^{-r}<1 for r>=6. The additive G recurrence and separate U endpoint theorem are not thereby refuted, but the old GU implication needs replacement.
